script.text: A new business has just been filed. For now, it's an empty lot.
It leases a building: commercial property coverage.
Its first employees: workers' comp, required in most states.
And when it opens to customers: general liability.
Every new asset is a new policy. And new and growing businesses need that coverage before they open.
We find new and expanding businesses in public filings and on their own websites, with the owner's name where it's public, and contact details.
Every Monday, as a PDF and a spreadsheet. Each lead goes to one agency only.
